gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-heebo: Fast and aggressive, Ethnocentric pushes its letters apart, with big bowls and stubby ascenders. But Heebo does the steady reading work, its tall central band and open-ended curves carrying text without a snag.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-hind-mysuru: Lowercase tops press close to the ascender height, and the text reads compact, with no calligraphic thinning. Hind Mysuru gives Ethnocentric's fast, spread-out letters a steady partner, since neither relies on stroke contrast.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-kedebideri: Ethnocentric races across the line with widely spaced letters and big bowls, smooth and unclogged. Yet Kedebideri's rounded, inviting letters and lofty x-height supply the friendly counterweight, so a loud heading never feels hostile.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-kufam: Letters pushed far apart give Ethnocentric its fast, aggressive stride, big bowls and all. And Kufam, drawn like neon tubing, reads smoothly down a column, its open e curves and dominant bodies keeping ascenders out of sight.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-liter: Fast and aggressive, Ethnocentric spreads its letters wide, while Liter draws every stroke with exactly no contrast, smooth as a pen plotter. One pushes forward, the other holds the line.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-michroma: Aggressive and fast, Ethnocentric sprints across the line, letters pushed apart. Michroma gives each letter a wide berth and leaves daylight in its curves, so the heading's speed meets a body that lets the eye slow down.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-miriam-libre: Aggressive and fast, Ethnocentric dashes along with its letters spread apart. Miriam Libre reads like drawn wire, approachable and modern, its s opening generously so a full page of it feels easy going.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-mochiy-pop-p-: Ethnocentric runs fast and aggressive, its letters pushed apart and its curves smooth, never clogged. Mochiy Pop P One is the pair's best trick: a monoline, generously spaced lowercase body that lets the heading be loud.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-noto-kufi-ara: Ethnocentric arrives fast and aggressive, with big bowls and letters pushed well apart. Noto Kufi Arabic meets it with a welcoming gap in the c and capitals barely above lowercase, a modern, clean partner.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-noto-sans-arm: Tall, full lowercase c, s and z and generous round openings make Noto Sans Armenian read warmly and approachably. Ethnocentric is all speed and bite; the body is all welcome.
